g.title: MetadataService
g.text: Authentication on https connection are handled by lib from gracenote.
Authentication on https connection are handled by lib conradlib

g.title: cluster_UNKNOWN
cluster_OUTSIDE_OF_UNIT
cluster_IVI

NetworkManager
componentType: Service securityClassification: low customAttributes: located in ConMod

Gracenote Backend
componentType: Service OutOfScope: True reasonOos: communication is handled by gracenote sdk, not esolutions component

gracenote-sdk
componentType: Service securityClassification: medium customAttributes: licensing done by CARIAD actually lib that handles the communication to the gracenote backend sdk provided by CARIAD

Gracenote Backend --> HTTPS (2) --> gracenote-sdk
technology: HTTPS OutOfScope: True reasonOos: communication is handled by gracenote sdk, not esolutions component

MetadataService
componentType: Own_Service securityClassification: medium modules: perforce-swarm.eso.local:8443/files/oi/metadataservice/metadataservice_app perforce-swarm.eso.local:8443/files/oi/metadataservice/metadataservice_app/metadataservice perforce-swarm.eso.local:8443/files/oi/metadataservice/metadataservice_app/gracenoteservice apks: MetadataService-prod-arm64-v8a-release-unsigned.apk customAttributes: provides Radio and Music metadata Low Secutity and Safety, but contractually it could potentially cause financial harm gracenote certificate is stored in the apk gracenote_sdk also SWE but delivered from Gracenote

MetadataServiceDEMO
componentType: Own_Service apks: MetadataService-prod-arm64-v8a-release-unsigned.apk debug: condition testcase securityClassification: medium customAttributes: used for testing and demonstration

MetadataService --> demo_activity --> MetadataServiceDEMO
technology: Android Service Consumption dataSanityIsGuaranteedFromSender: False serviceProtocol: AIDL customAttributes: Activity in side MetadataService (own_service) representing a engineering services for verifying functionality debug: condition testcase

Client(s)
componentType: Application securityClassification: medium customAttributes: They have to handle the licensed data and should reasonably securely handle it Low Secutity and Safety, but contractually it could potentially cause financial harm Provides: HCPG-64 - metadataservice_clientinterface (as client libraries/SDK) current radio(eso) and media(harman), erlebnis innenraum (audi)

MetadataService --> technology.cariad.entertainment.metadataserviceclient.api.IMetadataServiceAid (2) --> Client(s)
technology: Android Service Provision dataSanityIsGuaranteedFromSender: True dataSanityIsCheckedAtReceiver: False destinationAuthenticatedBy: ANDROID_SYSTEM services: technology.cariad.entertainment.metadataservice.service.MetadataService serviceProtocol: AIDL customAttributes: protected by technology.cariad.entertainment.metadataservice.USE_SERVICE protection: signature/privileged provide: text metadata provide: lyrics provide: URL for radio stations, getting from conradlib request assets: INT

MetadataService --> technology.cariad.entertainment.metadataservice.contentprovider.MetadataImageProvider --> Client(s)
technology: Android Content Provider Read dataSanityIsGuaranteedFromSender: True dataSanityIsCheckedAtReceiver: False destinationAuthenticatedBy: LINUX_KERNEL readProtection: PERMISSION customAttributes: provide url to file system clients will checked for permissions to request the URI clients provide e.g. name of songs/album protected by technology.cariad.entertainment.metadataservice.USE_SERVICE authority: technology.cariad.entertainment.metadataservice.MetadataService.ImageProvider

metadataservice-data
shared: True componentType: File_System storesCredentials: False signed: False removableStorage: False storesLogData: False encrypted: True reasonOos: informational purpose of getting files provider writeAccess: True OutOfScope: True customAttributes: stored in the ESM stores big files in order to share them with the clients via descriptors (FileProvider API) Shared to a limited audience, only clients explicitly allowed to access certain files stores a database containing the local config (e. g. connection handling behavior, text based, no authentication data ...) Clients get read only permissions actual path -> path provided by lib from harman stores data in /data/vendor/extended-storage/metadataservice-data/** -> encrypted by standard Android filesystem encryption

MetadataService --> File Write --> metadataservice-data
technology: File Write dataSanityIsGuaranteedFromSender: False sourceAuthenticatedBy: NO_ONE OutOfScope: True reasonOos: informational purpose of getting files provider customAttributes: authentication process handled by harman storing cover arts assets: GDPR CONF

MetadataService --> FunctionCall (1) --> gracenote-sdk
technology: Function Call dataSanityIsGuaranteedFromSender: True customAttributes: metdataservice is configuring 3 things: TLS version to 1.2 and 1.3 which trust store will be used if TLS is enabled assets: INT

Android System
componentType: Android_System customAttributes: AndroidService provides login OAuth2 token for ConRad Backend handled by metadataservice_conradlib

MetadataService --> android.net.ConnectivityManager (1) --> Android System
technology: Android Service Consumption dataSanityIsGuaranteedFromSender: True dataSanityIsCheckedAtReceiver: False sourceAuthenticatedBy: ANDROID_SYSTEM serviceProtocol: AIDL customAttributes: protected by android.permission.CHANGE_NETWORK_STATE protected by android.permission.INTERNET

media, radio
componentType: Android_System

MetadataService --> android.media.MediaRecorder (1) --> media, radio
technology: Android Service Consumption dataSanityIsGuaranteedFromSender: True dataSanityIsCheckedAtReceiver: False sourceAuthenticatedBy: ANDROID_SYSTEM serviceProtocol: AIDL customAttributes: only protocol related data, request audio snippet protected by android.permission.CAPTURE_AUDIO_OUTPUT assets: INT

Navi
componentType: Service securityClassification: medium customAttributes: used to retrieve position of car

MetadataService --> com.vwg.hcp3.nav.positioninformation.IPositionInformation (2) --> Navi
technology: Android Service Consumption dataSanityIsGuaranteedFromSender: True dataSanityIsCheckedAtReceiver: False sourceAuthenticatedBy: ANDROID_SYSTEM services: de.eso.navi.headless.positioninformation.PositionInformationAidlImpl serviceProtocol: AIDL customAttributes: protected by com.volkswagenag.nav.NAV_CORE_USER protected by android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION protected by android.permission.ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION only Callback registration assets: INT

metadataservice_conradlib
componentType: Service securityClassification: high customAttributes: lib included in and used solely by Metadata Service (Media) communicates with ConnectedRadio_Backend

MetadataService --> Function Call (1) --> metadataservice_conradlib
technology: Function Call dataSanityIsGuaranteedFromSender: False customAttributes: e.g. mobile country code assets: INT

metadataservice_gmdlib
componentType: Service securityClassification: medium customAttributes: lib included in and used solely by Metadata Service (Media) communicates with GMD Backend

MetadataService --> Function Call (4) --> metadataservice_gmdlib
technology: Function Call dataSanityIsGuaranteedFromSender: False dataSanityIsCheckedAtReceiver: False customAttributes: provide base URLs (received by coreservices/magicadapter) gmd lib add relative URL path, adapt e.g. artist id assets: INT

Client(s) --> technology.cariad.entertainment.metadataserviceclient.api.IMetadataServiceAid (1) --> MetadataService
technology: Android Service Consumption dataSanityIsGuaranteedFromSender: False dataSanityIsCheckedAtReceiver: True sourceAuthenticatedBy: ANDROID_SYSTEM services: technology.cariad.entertainment.metadataservice.service.MetadataService serviceProtocol: AIDL customAttributes: can request: - data textual radio -> ConnectedRadio - textual for media -> Gracenote Backend - based on audio signal currently playing -> Android (media, radio) system get audio schnipsel metadata for radio stations, songs, coverart assets: GDPR INT

metadataservice-data --> File Read (2) --> MetadataService
technology: File Read dataSanityIsCheckedAtReceiver: False OutOfScope: True reasonOos: informational purpose of getting files provider customAttributes: authentication process handled by harman, no other process have write access to the folder, it is created by harman, location can be different reading cover arts assets: GDPR CONF

metadataservice-data --> File Read (1) --> Client(s)
technology: File Read dataSanityIsCheckedAtReceiver: False OutOfScope: True reasonOos: informational purpose of getting files provider customAttributes: reading cover arts assets: GDPR CONF

gracenote-sdk --> HTTPS (1) --> Gracenote Backend
technology: HTTPS OutOfScope: True reasonOos: communication is handled by gracenote sdk, not esolutions component

gracenote-sdk --> FunctionCall (2) --> MetadataService
technology: Function Call dataSanityIsCheckedAtReceiver: True customAttributes: metadata: e.g. coverart, title, artist assets: GDPR

Android System --> android.net.ConnectivityManager (2) --> MetadataService
technology: Android Service Provision dataSanityIsGuaranteedFromSender: False dataSanityIsCheckedAtReceiver: True destinationAuthenticatedBy: ANDROID_SYSTEM serviceProtocol: AIDL customAttributes: provide network interfaces for connecting to backend protected by android.permission.CHANGE_NETWORK_STATE protected by android.permission.INTERNET assets: INT

Android System --> android_sharedPerf --> MetadataService
technology: File Read destinationAuthenticatedBy: ANDROID_SYSTEM dataSanityIsCheckedAtReceiver: False customAttributes: used for demo activity settings debug: condition testcase

media, radio --> android.media.MediaRecorder (2) --> MetadataService
technology: Android Service Provision dataSanityIsGuaranteedFromSender: False dataSanityIsCheckedAtReceiver: False destinationAuthenticatedBy: ANDROID_SYSTEM serviceProtocol: AIDL customAttributes: provide sound data for searching meta data forwarded to Gracenote protected by android.permission.CAPTURE_AUDIO_OUTPUT

Navi --> com.vwg.hcp3.nav.positioninformation.IPositionInformation (1) --> MetadataService
technology: Android Service Provision dataSanityIsGuaranteedFromSender: False dataSanityIsCheckedAtReceiver: True destinationAuthenticatedBy: ANDROID_SYSTEM services: de.eso.navi.headless.positioninformation.PositionInformationAidlImpl serviceProtocol: AIDL customAttributes: protected by com.volkswagenag.nav.NAV_CORE_USER protected by android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION protected by android.permission.ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION position of car (e.g., GPS coordinates) assets: GDPR

metadataservice_conradlib --> Function Call (2) --> MetadataService
technology: Function Call dataSanityIsCheckedAtReceiver: False customAttributes: provide URL for radio stations, will be forwarded to radio client assets: INT

metadataservice_gmdlib --> Function Call (3) --> MetadataService
technology: Function Call dataSanityIsGuaranteedFromSender: False dataSanityIsCheckedAtReceiver: False customAttributes: metadata information assets: INT

MagicAdapter
componentType: Service securityClassification: medium customAttributes: provided Service: ServicelistAPI; DisabledReasonAPI

MagicAdapter --> vendor.coreservices.systemservice.{ServiceListApiCallback, DisableReasonsApiCallback, TrustStoreCallback} --> MetadataService
technology: Function Call dataSanityIsGuaranteedFromSender: False dataSanityIsCheckedAtReceiver: True customAttributes: provide service list, disabled reasons URLs, api endpoints protected by technology.cariad.magic.service.permission.ALL TrustStoreCallback: pem format -> certificates assets: INT

/product/priv-app/ --> File Read (3) --> MetadataService

android_VHAL
componentType: Android_System customAttributes: abstraction for vehicle properties

android_VHAL --> MOBILE_COUNTRY_CODE --> MetadataService
